chunks: And gave them a clear exposition of Our laws. And they did not differ until after knowledge came to them, through mutual jealousies. Verily your Lord will judge between them on the Day of Judgement in what they differed about.
ai.seo_question: Why did people start disputing after receiving divine knowledge?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights that the root of sectarian division is not ignorance but 'bagh' (arrogant self-seeking) among those who possess clear knowledge of divine truth. It underscores that God’s final judgment will resolve these theological disputes, serving as a reminder for the faithful to adhere to the true interpretation of the 'clear proofs' (Bayinat) to avoid similar divisions.
